prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: side impact at intersection. Injury: shoulder injury. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1217; do not mention it.)
text:
Our firm represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with injuries sustained in a collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE] at a signalized intersection. Our client was proceeding lawfully through the intersection when your insured failed to yield the right of way and struck the driver's side of our client's vehicle. The police report and the physical damage to both vehicles are consistent with our client's account of the event.

As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a serious shoulder injury. Imaging and treatment records document a torn rotator cuff requiring ongoing physical therapy, restricted range of motion, and pain that interferes with daily work and household activities. Our client's treating physicians have not yet cleared him for full duty, and future care may be necessary.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured's own statement acknowledges that the signal had changed before the vehicle entered the intersection. We have enclosed the medical records, billing statements, wage loss documentation, and photographs of the vehicle damage.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims against your insured arising from this incident. This offer remains open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
